justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-distinguished enum with carrying data (OutOfRange value, InvalidCharacter char), though NotCanonical could be split into more specific variants for better domain modeling.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants, no panics or unwraps in library code, and Result is used consistently throughout.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives on the error type and Display is implemented, but no doc comments exist on any public item (functions, error type, or variants).
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses matches!, iterators, and derives appropriately, but the from_roman parsing does redundant work by both parsing greedily and then re-validating via round-trip to to_roman rather than relying on a single canonical approach.
